name: Shemiramoth
overview: Shemiramoth appears in Scripture as a faithful Levite musician and servant of God, specifically involved in temple worship through his role with psalteries and harps, as seen in 1 Chronicles 15:18, 20 and 16:5. Additionally, he was among the Levites sent by King Jehoshaphat to instruct the people in the law, demonstrating his dedication not only to worship but also to teaching God's Word (2 Chronicles 17:8). These passages highlight Shemiramoth’s integral part in both the spiritual worship and educational life of Israel under the guidance of God.
